seoTitle: Google Ads for Hair Salons & Barbershops: Complete Guide
description: Google Ads for hair salons, barbershops and nail salons: setup, keywords, budgets, common mistakes and city guides, written for owners starting small.
intro: This guide collects our Google Ads articles for hair salons, barbershops, nail salons and beauty clinics. It covers setup, keywords and negative keywords, budgets, common mistakes, UK advice and city-by-city notes. It is for owners who want new clients from people searching for a salon right now, and who want to avoid wasting money while they learn.

If your budget is limited, read the budget and mistakes articles first so you know what to expect. Then start with a small campaign focused on a few high-intent keywords in your local area, with a clear booking page behind it. Review the search terms weekly and add negatives before raising spend.

A basic campaign is doable yourself if you can check it regularly. Trouble usually comes from broad keywords, weak landing pages and untracked bookings. If you would rather not risk the budget, DataLatte can set up and manage campaigns for you, but there is no obligation, and the guides here are free to use.

faq.q: How much should a hair salon spend on Google Ads?
faq.a: It depends on your city, competition and how many new clients you want. Many owners start with a modest monthly test and increase only once bookings are tracked. Our budget articles explain how to think about it, and costs change often.

faq.q: What keywords should a salon bid on?
faq.a: Usually high-intent local searches such as a service plus your area or near me, rather than broad terms like hair. Add negative keywords to block jobs, courses and unrelated searches. Our keyword articles list examples to adapt.

faq.q: Are Google Ads better than Instagram ads for salons?
faq.a: They do different jobs. Google Ads reach people actively searching, while Instagram ads show your work to people who were not looking yet. Many salons start with Google for ready-to-book clients.

faq.q: Why are my salon Google Ads not getting bookings?
faq.a: Common causes are broad keywords, a slow or confusing booking page, and no conversion tracking. Check search terms and your landing page first. Our mistakes article goes through the usual fixes.
